mentions.name: Bonsai
mentions.description: An open-source conversational framework for building brand-safe assistants and agents that operate over text and voice channels. Example builds include an email agent that qualifies leads and sends back PDF offers, and a voice-based AI podcaster that conducted interviews in a physical space.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Bonsai - an open-source conversational framework for brand-safe assistants and agents. It works with text and voice based channels.
